name: plasma-auto-tiler-kwin
description: KWin scripting component for Plasma Auto Tiler. Development-only toolchain; KWin executes only the generated non-module bundle.

scripts.test: npm run build && rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild "tests/*.test.ts" --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=es2020 --outdir=dist/tests && node --test "dist/tests/**/*.test.js" && bash ../scripts/start-test.test.sh
